technologies.name: All in One SEO Pro
technologies.evidence: Homepage meta generator: All in One SEO Pro (AIOSEO) 5.0.5; Site Kit by Google 1.191.0; Elementor 4.3.6; features: e_font_icon_svg, additional_custom_breakpoints; settings: css_print_method-external, google_font-enabled, font_display-swap

technologies.name: Elementor
technologies.evidence: Homepage meta generator names Elementor and version. Stylesheet and script URLs include /wp-content/plugins/elementor/.

technologies.name: Site Kit by Google
technologies.evidence: Homepage meta generator names Site Kit by Google. Script URLs include /wp-content/plugins/google-site-kit/.

technologies.name: WordPress
technologies.evidence: Public pages serve /wp-content/, /wp-includes/, and the WordPress REST API at /wp-json/.

technologies.name: PixFort theme and pixfort-core
technologies.evidence: Homepage markup uses pixfort header classes and loads /wp-content/plugins/pixfort-core/ assets. PixFort plugin version query on index.bundle was 4.4.2.

technologies.name: WooCommerce
technologies.evidence: Homepage loads WooCommerce assets (JS version 11.2.1). The public store catalog at /wp-json/wc/store/v1/products returned zero products.

technologies.name: Jetpack
technologies.evidence: Homepage loads Jetpack CSS and references stats.wp.com and s0.wp.com.

technologies.name: WordPress.com font service
technologies.evidence: Stylesheets are loaded from fonts-api.wp.com for families: Inter, Roboto, Roboto Slab

technologies.name: Swiper
technologies.evidence: Homepage HTML contains Swiper class or script references.

technologies.name: WordPress.com / Automattic hosting
technologies.evidence: Direct response headers on https://elatre.com/wp-json/ included host-header WordPress.com, server nginx, and an Automattic x-hacker header.

technologies.name: MailPoet
technologies.evidence: The public REST index lists a mailpoet/v1 namespace. MailPoet markup was not confirmed in the homepage HTML.

unknowns: Server-side application code, database, and hosting plan details are not public.
